about: The service button (zadania/zrobione/CR-05.md): lb_node_factory_reset() takes the same path as FactoryReset from the hub, minus the reply — accepted at once, the state goes RESETTING (above IDENTIFY), carried out 50 ms later. Without a restart hook the node forgets the address and an Identify in progress, and joins again; jitter 1500.

steps.note: the button: nothing goes on the bus
done: no address, Identify gone with the rest
